<!-- The numbers, figures and tables in the paper are made here, not in the
     manuscript. octavo build watches the .qmd and runs quarto render when needed. -->

```{python}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
# Load octavo_helper.py from this same analysis/ folder. When octavo build runs this,
# OCTAVO_ROOT is set, so it is found wherever it runs from.
import os, sys
root = os.environ.get("OCTAVO_ROOT")
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(root, "analysis") if root else ".")
from octavo_helper import *
ov_style()   # embed figure text in the PDF as text, and use a Japanese font if there is one
```
